findings.citation: plan.md Task A: non-ASCII letters are not letters for this helper
findings.scenario: No test covers non-ASCII input. Current behaviour is correct (ran: slugify('Café au lait') -> 'caf-au-lait', slugify('ÄÖÜ') -> ''), but a change to \p{L} or transliteration would pass all existing tests.

findings.citation: plan.md Task A acceptance: the input is never mutated
findings.scenario: Test 'the input is never mutated' cannot fail because JS strings are immutable primitives; the guarantee holds by language semantics, so this is advisory.
